states.CLEAR: No active writer and no hard provider fence.
states.LEASED: Exactly one writer owns the bounded lane until release or expiry.
states.SENT_DNR: Provider accepted a send; exact lane is do-not-resend until a genuine human event.
states.DEAD_ROUTE: Provider rejected the route; route failure is not buyer rejection and the exact route remains blocked.
states.HUMAN_EVENT_REOPEN: A genuine human event reopened one bounded next action.
states.HOLD: Manual or policy hold; no lease acquisition is allowed.

invariants: collision keys are deterministic after normalization
at most one unexpired lease exists for a collision key
provider SENT hard-fences the exact lane against duplicate acquisition
provider bounce is DEAD_ROUTE, never buyer rejection
only the active lease holder may record provider SENT or BOUNCE
lease expiry must be time-valid before recovery
HUMAN_EVENT may reopen SENT_DNR but does not resurrect DEAD_ROUTE
every event emits a hash-chained receipt, including denied transitions
